title: Blue Emergency Notification System (ENS) Sign Posted at Every Highway-Rail Grade Crossing

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Only a single freight train on the tracks in background; no two vehicles facing each other in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No car interior or steering wheel visible; scene shows a man standing outdoors by a signal post.

single_bulb_signal.note: Left mast shows one red lit and one dark; foreground mast shows one red lit lens with adjacent lens dark/unlit; at most one lit lens per signal.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: No roadway travel lane, centerline, or road vehicles visible; only railroad tracks and grassy verge.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; blue plaque shows only white phone-handset icon, crossbuck and signals are blank shapes.

scene_match.note: Shows blue phone-icon plaque on railroad signal post with man calling and train passing, but plaque is vertical and lacks barcode-style locator bar, and is not horizontal as prompted.

result.summary: Image is text-free and signal-compliant showing a blue ENS-type phone plaque at a rail crossing, but plaque orientation is vertical and missing the locator bar, requiring human review.

teaching_correct.note: Teaches learner to locate blue emergency phone sign on gate mast and call from safe position off tracks; no wrong geometry or opposite lesson.

result.what_i_see: A man stands in grass in foreground beside a railroad signal mast with flashing red lights, looking at a vertical royal-blue plaque with a white telephone handset icon while holding a phone to his ear, with a freight train passing on tracks behind at sunset.
